'''Silver's Gyarados''' (Japanese: '''シルバーのギャラドス''' ''Silver's Gyarados'') is a {{Shiny}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that {{adv|Silver}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his eighth overall. He is also the [[Red Gyarados]] of the [[Lake of Rage]] incident. As of ''[[PS454|All About Arceus III]]'', he is at [[level]] 80, and his [[Characteristic]] is that he "likes to thrash about."

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}===
[[File:Red Gyarados Adventures debut.png|thumb|left|180px|Gyarados enraged due to Team Rocket's radio waves]]
Prior to ''[[PS112|Raise the Red Gyarados]]'', Gyarados was the leader of a group of {{p|Magikarp}} at the [[Lake of Rage]]. When [[Team Rocket]] used the [[Goldenrod City]] {{FB|Goldenrod|Radio Tower}} to disturb Pokémon with their [[Evolution]]-inducing waves, the Magikarp started to suddenly evolve into Gyarados and began to act crazy. When {{adv|Gold}} and {{adv|Silver}} arrived and saw what was happening they began attacking the Gyarados while searching for the signal that was causing it. Gyarados soon pops up from out of the water and Gold's and Silver's Pokégears have an even stronger connection, meaning that he was the source of the waves. The two decide to capture him to stop the waves and have [[Polibo]] and {{TP|Silver|Murkrow}} weaken him, allowing Silver to catch him.

In ''[[PS114|Delibird Delivery - 2]]'', Gyarados fought against the [[Masked Man]]. Silver had Gyarados bring all the Gyarados that were forcibly evolved upon the Masked Man and has them launch a powerful {{m|Hyper Beam}}. The attack is later seen to have failed as the entire lake is frozen and Silver is unconscious.
[[File:Red Gyarados searching for Silver.png|thumb|left|180px|Gyarados searching for Silver]]
In ''[[PS140|Do-Si-Do with Dodrio]]'', it is revealed that Gyarados was frozen at the bottom of the Lake of Rage. After [[Lt. Surge]] finds him he wakes up and immediately rushes over to where he thinks Silver is and attempts to break him out as well, but fails due to his exhausted state. Lt. Surge breaks the ice open for him and discovers some of Gold and Silver's things. Realizing they have a connection to the Masked Man he decides to take Gyarados with him and heads off to [[Morty]] to search for the two. In ''[[PS145|Sandslash Surprise]]'', Gyarados is returned to Silver.

In ''[[PS161|Entranced by Entei]]'', Gyarados battled a wild {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Entei}}. Alongside [[Gyara]], {{adv|Red}}'s Gyarados under {{adv|Blue}}'s command, the two fire powerful {{m|Dragon Rage|Dragon}} {{m|Dragon Breath|attacks}}. However, Entei shrugs them off and flees. 

In ''[[PS177|The Last Battle XI]]'', Gyarados battled alongside Silver's other Pokémon to defeat [[Will]] by attacking with {{TP|Silver|Sneasel}}'s {{m|Beat Up}}.

==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}===
[[File:Silver and Gyarados.png|thumb|200px|Gyarados and Silver]]
In ''[[PS289|Surprised by Sneasel]]'', Gyarados battled [[Sird]] and her {{p|Banette}}. Gyarados attacks with a {{m|Fire Blast}} but it is dodged and Banette counters with {{m|Shadow Ball}}. Gyarados then tries to heal his injuries with {{m|Rest}}, but Banette eats the move with {{m|Snatch}}, allowing herself to be healed instead. Banette attacks Gyarados with a {{m|Double-Edge}} and Silver retaliates by having Gyarados attack with Fire Blast again. {{adv|Yellow}} and [[Orm]]'s battle soon starts and Orm's {{p|Jumpluff}} releases several spores which have multiple different effects. One of them hits Gyarados and puts him to sleep, taking him out of the fight.

In ''[[PS301|Storming the Forretress]]'', after {{adv|Giovanni}} was defeated and [[Carr]] sent the [[Team Rocket airship]] containing him, Silver, his loyal subordinates, and enemies crashing, Gyarados teamed up with the other {{type|Water}} Pokémon to try to keep the airship in place. However, ultimately, it was {{adv|Mew}} who saved it.

==={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}===
In ''[[PS445|Dealing With A Koffing Fit]]'', Silver arrives at Lance's [[Whirl Islands|secret hideout]] and is soon attacked by a group of [[Petrel]]'s {{p|Koffing}}. Gyarados fought alongside the rest of Silver's team to drive off the large horde of the Poison Gas Pokémon.

In ''[[PS446|Weavile Wobbles But It Won't Fall Down]]'', Silver used Gyarados while facing Petrel for the first time in the {{Safari|Johto}}. Gyarados first saved Silver from a falling bridge and after that was used as intimidation in order to get Petrel's [[Plate]]s. He was later seen training alongside Silver's other {{t|Water}} types.

==={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===
Gyarados appeared in a fantasy in ''[[PS362|Dramatic Drapion & Crafty Kricketune I]]'', when {{adv|Diamond}} recalled a pair of comedians who put on a show about how Gyarados used to live at the Lake of Rage.

==Personality and characteristics==
When {{adv|Silver}} first met Gyarados, he displayed typical characteristics of his [[Pokémon (species)|species]]. He was depicted as angry and enraged, attacking every nearby person and Pokémon and not calming down for a second, although this was due to his rage at [[Team Rocket]]'s [[Evolution]] waves. Gyarados is an extremely powerful Pokémon and was once the leader of a group of Gyarados. Gyarados also cares greatly for his {{pkmn|Trainer}}, as shown when he wore himself down to exhaustion trying to save him from his ice imprisonment despite only being caught recently.

==Trivia==
* Gyarados is the first [[Shiny Pokémon]] seen in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga.
* Gyarados is the only one of Silver's {{type|Water}} Pokémon that did not evolve under his ownership, as it was caught already in his final stage, unlike {{p|Kingdra}} and {{TP|Silver|Feraligatr}}, who were received in their initial stage.
* Gyarados is Silver's only {{cat|Generation I Pokémon}}.
